name: Web Family Gateway, parent linking, and telemetry contract
acceptanceCriteria: Web family gateway supports clear segmentation between Teen and Bip Jr. + Family onboarding paths.
Parent linking contract preserves mutual consent and 8-character invite code verification via public.parent_links.
Anonymous and authenticated telemetry insertion is enabled for signup_attempted and teen_age_selected funnel tracking.

Public Teen front door uses the exact founder-selected Family artwork with five accessible companion previews; private Discover reuses its portrait crops without bypassing age/auth or companion unlock restrictions.

verification.blocker: Exact-head CI and public production browser readback have not yet passed.

rollback: Revert only the front-door presentation and best-effort telemetry call sites on the verified source branch; retain the previous auth/age/parent routes and preserve existing Supabase tables and data. Production rollback requires an independently authorized deployment.
